matches.rationale: No finding captures the cross-section inconsistency between the abstract's claim of training-free operation and the method's implication of training. The only finding mentioning training (pred_id 1) identifies an internal contradiction within the abstract, not a cross-section misalignment.

The ground truth describes an asymmetric fusion formula with scaling ratios that can produce negative weights. No finding detects this specific equation or its instability; pred_id 4 discusses a different formula with weights that should sum to 1.
The ground truth concerns omitted GPU/batch-size asymmetry biasing comparisons. No finding mentions hardware or batch-size disparities.
The ground truth involves boosted accuracy numbers by 3-5% in Tables 2 and 3. The only related finding (pred_id 6) flags zero standard deviations, not inflated accuracy values.
The ground truth points to qualitative examples overclaiming robustness while showing ambiguous responses. No finding discusses qualitative examples or overfitting to noisy context.
The ground truth notes missing IRB approvals, consent, and privacy safeguards in the appendix. No finding addresses ethical omissions.
The ground truth flags references with future dates and imaginary authors. No finding detects bibliographic fabrication.
The ground truth concerns promotional rhetoric in the introduction overstating performance. No finding addresses rhetorical exaggeration.
The ground truth describes a numerical discrepancy between text and Figure 1 regarding ranking-based accuracy. No finding identifies this figure–text mismatch.
The ground truth involves mixing heterogeneous baselines without proper normalization. No finding mentions baseline comparability or model size control.

The ground truth is a cross-section inconsistency between Section 6.3 scaling well and Section 6.5 performance decline. The closest finding (pred_id 5) addresses a figure mis-citation, not contradictory scalability claims.
The ground truth notes missing bias/safety evaluations of knowledge bases. No finding detects this omission.
The ground truth flags misattributed references such as GPT-4 technical report. No finding covers reference misattribution.
The ground truth highlights that the conclusion omits limitations and uses selective rhetoric. No finding addresses conclusion-level omission.
The ground truth notes that the related work ignores recent training-free fusion techniques. No finding mentions omitted literature.
The ground truth concerns omission of causal mask preservation in attention reallocation formulas. No finding discusses causal masks or autoregressive constraints.
